provenance.flourine_artifact: rsync of the Mac artifacts/flourine_dl/flourine-artifact; digest recorded in flourine_artifact_digest
provenance.flourine_artifact_digest: bms/c + translations_only: 7958 files, sha256 over (relpath, sha256) 5e7f65ec1ab8e3df82df3e0dfdf08ec37b5affbd81bd06c7065509c9cc085e1c, equal on the Mac copy, this copy and the copy the original run used

rule:
harness/mutate_full_flourine.py (results/flourine_mutation.json) calls batch_diff.tally with no
sanitizer, so a mutant counts as killed on any input where its output differs from the C's
(gcc -O1 -fwrapv), whether or not the C is UB-clean there. The defect count applies the full UB
rule to every divergence (harness/oracle_ub_flourine*.py). This script applies the same rule to the
mutation kills.
